logic.bm: GTD business area: oil-immersed power transformers, shunt reactors and autotransformers (Betim/MG plant bought from TSEA in 2020), distribution and power transformers (Blumenau/SC, Gravataí/RS — voltage classes up to 230 kV per WEG news 2024), substations/E-houses, specialty transformers 1–10 MVA up to 46.5 kV in Washington, Missouri (WEG Transformers USA, ex-CG Power USA), hydro/thermal generators, steam turbines (TGM), wind turbines, distributed & centralized solar; since May-2024 Marathon generators (US data-center backup power). Consolidated revenue also includes industrial motors/drives (EEI), commercial motors (MCA) and paints (T&V).
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

structural_breaks.note: CG Power USA Inc. (Washington, Missouri transformer plant; renamed WEG Transformers USA) acquired — announced 21-Jun-2017, consolidated from Aug-2017 (3T17 release: 'eliminados os efeitos da consolidação da aquisição da CG Power USA'). Adds US-made transformers to GTD external.
TGM (Brazilian steam-turbine maker) control acquisition approved by CADE 28-Feb-2018 and consolidated into GTD (Brazil) from 1T18.
Agreement with TSEA to buy its Betim/MG power-transformer plant (32,500 m², power transformers, shunt reactors, autotransformers) — GTD Brazil capacity.

Data-availability break: absolute GTD revenue (Mercado Interno/Externo) is printed in releases only from 2T20 (with 2T19-4T19 and 1T20 as comparatives/prior quarter). Earlier releases give only qualitative/percent business-area commentary; no GTD values before FY2019Q2.
Regal Rexnord industrial motors & generators businesses (Marathon, Rotor, Cemp) consolidated from May-2024; generators (Marathon) enter GTD external (29.7% of the acquired revenue in 2T24 = GTD).
Reivax (excitation/control systems) and Volt Electric Motors consolidation effects cited in 1T25 release when adjusting growth.
